item.title: 'World of Warcraft' expansion roadmap detailed, goes free until Feb 1st — Midnight includes mega solo dungeon Labyrinths, mini raids, and more
item.description: At the World of Warcraft "State of Azeroth" event, Blizzard detailed the future of the Midnight expansion, touted as the dark middle act of the Worldsoul saga.

item.title: Microsoft promises 2026 will be a better year for Windows 11 — confirms plans to address "pain points" across the OS
item.description: Windows 11's biggest pain points are to be addressed this year, Microsoft's Windows president Pavan Davuluri has said.

item.title: I found a Linux user who switched to Windows 11 after 8 years of distros — and he actually prefers it. Here's why.
item.description: After several years on Linux, a power user switched to Windows 11, and here's his experience and why he likes the operating system.

item.title: The Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Warzone Season 2 roadmap is here, and it's gigantic — a new battle royale mode inspired by Blackout is coming, too
item.description: One week ahead of Season 2's arrival in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Warzone, its devs have revealed the roadmap and everything coming to both games.

item.title: This powerhouse CPU with 8 cores and a 5.0GHz boost clock is off by 14% — a timely deal to upgrade your gaming PC with before prices get too extreme
item.description: Amazon is hosting a special 14% discount for the AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D, a mighty mid-range CPU that will castly your PC gaming experience with 8 cores, 16 threads, a max clock boost of 5GHz, and more.

item.title: This huge Fallout game is free for a week ahead of the TV show's Season 2 finale — Bethesda advertised it with Twitch star Shroud in a new commercial
item.description: Bethesda has made Fallout 76 free to play across all platforms for a week, and advertised the series' games with a new commercial that stars Shroud.

item.title: Microsoft loses a massive $440 billion in market cap as shares tank — investors get increasingly sceptical of its AI strategy
item.description: Microsoft investors didn't enjoy the company's FY26 Q2 report, as fears of its AI strategy begin to unravel into despair.

item.title: We asked you if that massive $900m lawsuit against Valve and Steam holds weight — and the people have spoken
item.description: We asked if you thought the huge UK lawsuit Valve is up against over anti-competitive practices with Steam holds weight, and you gave a clear answer.

item.title: 80% of game devs plan to target Windows PC in survey — with only 40% for PS5 and Nintendo Switch 2, and 20% for Xbox. It's lucky the next Xbox is a PC then, eh?
item.description: Steam and Windows stays winning, as console support no longer seems to be a priority for game devs.

item.title: Microsoft explores bringing Linux-like top menu bar to Windows 11 with new PowerToys feature
item.description: Microsoft's PowerToys team is exploring a new feature that would add a menu bar to the top of the Windows desktop, offering power user shortcuts similar to the menu bar on a Mac or Linux distro.
